DaisyHelloText:
DAISY: Hi! My kid
brother is the GYM

LEADER in VIRIDIAN
CITY.

But he goes out
of town so often,

it causes problems
for the trainers.
DaisyOfferGroomingText:
DAISY: Hi! Good
timing. I'm about to have some tea.

Would you like to
join me?

Oh, your #MON
are a bit dirty.

Would you like me
to groom one?
DaisyWhichMonText:
DAISY: Which one
should I groom?
DaisyAlrightText:
DAISY: OK, I'll
get it looking nice in no time.
DaisyAllDoneText:
DAISY: There you
go! All done.

See? Doesn't it
look nice?

It's such a cute
#MON.
DaisyAlreadyGroomedText:
DAISY: I always
have tea around

this time. Come
join me.
DaisyRefusedText:
DAISY: You don't
want to have one

groomed? OK, we'll
just have tea.
DaisyCantGroomEggText:
DAISY: Oh, sorry.
I honestly can't groom an EGG.
